modules.title: 一样大 vs 分了层

items.title: 大小
items.text: 越重要的越大。主标题明显大于副标题，副标题明显大于正文——差距要拉开到一眼能分。

items.title: 颜色深浅
items.text: 重要内容用深色，次要内容浅一档；全页一个颜色深浅就等于没有主次。

items.title: 位置和底色
items.text: 页面越靠上越先被看到；按钮靠底色而不是靠字号跳出，图片本身就是视觉锚点。

modules.title: 它不是什么
modules.text: 视觉层级不等于排版——排版只负责文字本身，层级管所有元素（按钮底色、图片、位置）被看到的先后。它也不是「内容顺序」：内容按阅读逻辑排，层级决定每块被看到的快慢。诊断口诀：眯眼看页面，第一落点是不是你想让访客先看的那个。

lessonPractice.title: 访客反馈首页「找不到重点」。看了页面发现标题、说明、按钮的字号几乎一样。下一步跟 AI 怎么说？

options.label: 按主次分层：主标题明显大于说明，主要按钮用底色突出
options.feedback: 对。让每层拉开差距（大小、颜色、底色），视线自然顺着「标题→说明→按钮」走，重点自己浮出来。

options.label: 在页面顶部再加一条大横幅写「重点在这里」
options.feedback: 再加一个同样大的元素只会多一个争抢视线的东西，乱上加乱。

options.label: 把所有文字整体缩小，页面就显得不挤了
options.feedback: 全部缩小后彼此的差距没变，依然分不出主次；挤和乱是两个问题。

en.title: Visitors say the homepage "has no focus." The title, description, and buttons are nearly the same size. What do you tell the AI?

options.label: Layer by importance: headline clearly larger, description secondary, main button filled
options.feedback: Correct. Widen the gaps (size, color, fill) so the eye travels title → description → button, and the focus emerges on its own.

options.label: Add a big banner at the top saying "the focus is here"
options.feedback: Another same-sized element just joins the fight for attention, adding clutter.

options.label: Shrink all the text so the page feels less crowded
options.feedback: Uniformly smaller text keeps the same ratios—still no order. Crowded and unordered are different problems.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 首页的层级重新排一下：主标题最大最粗，说明文字小一档、颜色浅一档，主要按钮保留底色，其他元素都别抢。改完我截图眯眼看一眼，第一眼落点应该是主标题。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Re-layer the homepage: headline biggest and boldest, description one step smaller and lighter, main button keeps its fill, nothing else competes. Afterward I'll squint at a screenshot—the first thing my eye lands on should be the headline.

learning.assumes: You have glanced at a poster and could name its headline.
learning.outcome: You can tell whether "messy" is a hierarchy problem, and direct the AI to assign size, shade, and position by importance.

items.title: Size
items.text: More important means bigger. Headline clearly above subtitle, subtitle clearly above body—gaps wide enough to tell apart at a glance.

items.title: Shade and fill
items.text: Key content in dark ink, secondary one shade lighter; buttons stand out by fill rather than font size.

items.title: Position
items.text: Higher on the page gets seen sooner—things in the hero are noticed before anything at the bottom.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Hierarchy is not typography—typography governs text size and weight, while hierarchy also covers color, position, and fill. It is not "content order" either: content follows reading logic, hierarchy decides how fast each block gets seen; they cooperate but differ. The diagnostic: squint at the page and check whether the first landing point is the one you wanted.

distinctions.label: Typography
distinctions.text: {c:typography} governs text alone; {c:visual-hierarchy} steers attention across everything—buttons, images, position included.

distinctions.label: Wireframe
distinctions.text: {c:wireframe} arranges which block sits where; {c:visual-hierarchy} decides which of those blocks gets seen first.
